# Ran Ma / 马然

> Bilingual portfolio for Ran Ma, a USC graduate student working across AI automation, business operations, data analytics, spatial economics, and international trade.

## Profile

- Name: Ran Ma (马然)
- Current role: AI Automation and Business Operations Assistant at Cayi Drink Tech
- Education: M.S. in Spatial Economics and Data Analysis, University of Southern California
- Undergraduate education: B.Econ. in International Business and Trade, Xiamen University Tan Kah Kee College
- Focus areas: AI workflow automation, operations systems, market research, logistics analytics, spatial analysis, Power BI, and international trade
- Languages: Chinese and English

## Selected work

- Cayi operations platform: designed and built an internal AI-assisted operations system connecting order records, approvals, status tracking, task notifications, and cross-functional workflows.
- AI market research automation: used Claude and Codex to automate Amazon and TikTok research across more than 10 brands and 300 products, reducing repetitive research time from about 20 hours to 4 hours.
- Dell Technologies logistics analytics: contributed to demand consolidation, ASN data cleaning, and Power BI dashboard support.
- APCG 2026 research: presented a tropical-fruit cultivation suitability study for Hawaiʻi Island and received the 2026 APCG Women’s Network Small Travel Grant.
